query: Do I need to book an appointment date for the oath-taking?
reference_answer: You are not required to book an appointment for oath-taking. You may proceed to ICA Services Centre and obtain an 'Oath-taking' queue ticket at the self-service kiosks. Please ensure you have the required documents to complete your Oath of Renunciation, Allegiance and Loyalty (ORAL).
answer: No, you don't need to book an appointment date for the oath-taking; it's typically done at a scheduled ceremony. [Document 1]
